figures.caption: Fig. 1. Architecture of Causal Adversarial Subspace Clustering for Multivariate Spatiotemporal Data (CASC) framework. CASC is composed of a deep subspace and clustering generator and a quality-verifying discriminator. The generator is composed of an autoencoder and a sampling layer. The autoencoder receives 4D multivariate spatiotemporal data as input and outputs cluster labels, self-expressive coefficient matrix and reconstructed data. The sampling layer receives as input the cluster labels, coefficient matrix and random noise vectors and outputs real clustered data features and fake data features. Both feature vectors are sent to the discriminator to determine real or fake data features while generating new data.
